notes: %chisq / %chi (an iterative chi-square merge-binning macro for a continuous predictor against a binary target) are byte-identical to the source. The source read 'test.ttd_dev' from an external libname (C:\Users\Lenovo\Downloads\fwdproject\test, not available here), so this bundle supplies a 15-row mock ttd_dev dataset with the same column shape the macro expects (LTV + a 0/1 GBI_TAG). One fix vs the source: 'group=10' -> 'groups=10' on the PROC RANK call - the source's 'group=' is not a documented PROC RANK option (GROUPS= is the SAS 9.4 option), so this looks like the author's own typo rather than a Jenner gap, and the same fix was applied in the KS_Macro_with_Weight.sas bundle (t004) in this PR.
